risks.title: Significant operating losses and accumulated deficit requiring additional capital
risks.score_rationale: 10-K explicitly states 'significant operating losses' with net losses of $103.3M (2025) and $187.1M (2024). Accumulated deficit of $628.8M as of December 31, 2025. Company expects continued losses and may require additional capital raising, creating potential shareholder dilution risk for a company still in development phase.

risks.title: Revenue dependency on uncertain collaboration success and milestone achievement
risks.score_rationale: 10-K emphasizes revenue generation depends on 'success of specified discovery and development activities' and 'achievement of specified discovery and development milestones' under collaboration agreements. Future revenue from 'option fees, regulatory and commercial milestones, and royalties' is explicitly described as having uncertain timing and achievement.

risks.title: Absence of FDA-approved drug products limiting direct commercialization revenue
risks.score_rationale: Company has no drug products approved or licensed for commercial sale. Only two proprietary programs in Phase 1 (SGR-1505, SGR-3515) with company strategically phasing out independent clinical development. Revenue dependent on software licensing and collaboration milestone payments rather than direct drug product sales.

risks.title: Operational restructuring execution risk and cost reduction realization
risks.score_rationale: May 2025 restructuring announced with expected $70M annual savings from phasing out independent clinical development and operational efficiency improvements. Realization of these cost savings and successful transition to partnership model carries execution risk.

risks.title: Intense competition in computational drug discovery and software markets
risks.score_rationale: 10-K references 'intense competition' in software solutions market with requirement to continually advance technology and match competitor offerings. Computational drug discovery space increasingly competitive with both established pharma and emerging biotech platforms.

risks.title: Drug development risks including regulatory approval uncertainty and clinical trial failures
risks.score_rationale: Proprietary drug programs subject to inherent risks of preclinical and clinical development. Company discontinued SGR-2921 program due to safety concerns (two deaths in AML patients). IND and regulatory approvals uncertain. Long development timelines and high failure rates characteristic of drug development.

risks.title: Dependency on collaborators' success for future revenue and strategic milestones
risks.score_rationale: 10-K states company 'plans to explore strategic partnerships for SGR-1505 and SGR-3515 programs to advance development beyond Phase 1.' Future revenue from these programs and others depends on partner success in development and commercialization. Morphic acquisition illustrates this dependency.

risks.title: Intellectual property licensing dependency and potential termination risks
risks.score_rationale: Company holds in-licenses from Columbia University and other licensors imposing 'specified royalty and other obligations.' Risk of material breach findings and license termination could impair ability to market software solutions and develop new products utilizing licensed technology.

ai_positioning.summary: While Schrodinger does not explicitly use the term artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K, the company's physics-based computational platform fundamentally relies on advanced algorithmic methods to predict molecular properties and optimize drug discovery. The platform's core function of predicting molecular properties with high accuracy and enabling rapid computational screening is AI-adjacent technology. The predictive toxicology initiative with Bill Melinda Gates Foundation further demonstrates application of predictive computational methods to reduce drug development risk.
evidence: Physics-based computational platform enabling discovery of high-quality molecules more rapidly and at lower cost
Platform capability to predict critical properties of molecules with high degree of accuracy
Computational solution for predicting off-target protein binding toxicity under Gates Foundation initiative
Computational screening and optimization in drug discovery collaboration with BMS and other partners
